data.signal_type: Mining Plant Installations, Relocations and Modernisation
data.description: Mining modernisation accounts for approximately 25% of new crane demand nationally. Deep-mining operations require high-capacity crawler and mobile cranes for shaft headgear, processing plant modules, and conveyor installations. Mpumalanga coal rail logistics (Transnet road-to-rail project) at stations including Camden, Tutuka, Majuba, Grootvlei, Kendal and Hendrina involves ongoing mechanical plant work requiring crane support.
